{"id":1914692063,"question_id":4045,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 1 week","timestamp":1770731218,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"1884 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1914692063/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Longest Balanced Subarray I","memory":"530.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int longestBalanced(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        int ans = 0;\n        \n        for(int l = 0 ; l<n ; l++)\n        {\n            unordered_set<int>evens , odds;\n\n            for(int r = l ; r<n ;r++)\n            {\n                if(nums[r] & 1) odds.insert(nums[r]);\n                else evens.insert(nums[r]);\n                \n                //checking the size of each set if same \n                if(odds.size() == evens.size()) ans = max(ans , r-l+1);\n            }\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"longest-balanced-subarray-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1685}
